name: file_name_search
description: Find corpus files by name or relative path substring (and optional glob). Does not search file contents. Use when looking for a document by filename; then call file_read with the returned path. For text inside files use file_search.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against file names / relative paths (e.g. SCORING_GUIDE or .md).

glob.description: Optional filename glob relative to corpus (e.g. **/*.md).
